children: Globaltech provided an update on its planned Nasdaq uplisting, noting its application is under review, a completed 1-for-3 reverse stock split, and governance enhancements.
Nasdaq application under review; company has not received approval and does not currently meet Nasdaq uplisting requirements.
Completed 1-for-3 reverse stock split on Aug 27, 2026 to help satisfy Nasdaq minimum share-price requirements.
Management aims to complete uplisting in Q4 2026 but completion is subject to Nasdaq approval and other customary conditions.
Board approved formation of Audit, Compensation, and Nominating & Corporate Governance committees to strengthen oversight and reporting.
Common stock trading on OTCQB; temporary post-split symbol GLTKD through Sept 24, 2026, expected to revert to GLTK on Sept 25, 2026.
This is an AI-powered summary. It may contain inaccuracies. Consider verifying important information with the source. Please note this summary is solely based on documents filed with the SEC.

title: Globaltech seeks Nasdaq uplisting after reverse 1-for-3 split; governance changes planned
